title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani seeks an opportunity to promote her new health mix at a supermarket, but the owner insults her product. Enraged by this, Anbu confronts him and demands an apology.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paramasivam cancels the wedding over Siddharth's past but later convinces Kalamma to let him marry Nalini. Ilamathi takes the newlyweds to a temple, angering Kalamma.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian asks Saravanan and Kathir to expose Arasi's past with Kumar to Karthikeyan. Later, Suganya's wedding news of Arasi delights Gandhimathi, but Kumar reacts bitterly.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Karthika grows jealous of Cheran as Kasturi tells Nadesan about her divorce. Meanwhile, Chozhan helps Nila with cards and romances her on the train, teased by Pallavan.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena and Shruthi gift Vijaya a saree for the Sangeeth. Emotional songs and guest visits set the stage as the couples dance and celebrate their Sangeeth ceremony.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Movie magic meets unstoppable fun in the Cinema Round with hilarious recreations and spectacular singing acts by junior singers. Tune in for a fun-filled cinematic celebration!

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The cooking battle turns fierce as contestants enter semi-finals, with comalis in spooky getups pairing with cooks. Fun takes over as comalis face a crazy watermelon challenge.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
description: The contestants on hold face a high stakes questionnaire task. Bold answers from Feroz Khan, Manivannan, and Aishwarya trigger fiery debates as only 10 can advance.
